description:
This file defines utility functions for handling promises in the GuzzleHttp
amespace, including queue management, promise inspection, aggregation, and race conditions.

classes.name: Utils
classes.description: Utility class providing static methods for promise handling, including creating a task queue, tasks, inspecting promises, waiting for promises, and aggregating multiple promises.

methods.name: queue
methods.description: Returns or sets the global task queue used for promise resolution.

methods.name: task
methods.description: Schedules a callable task to run in the task queue and returns a promise representing its completion.

methods.name: inspect
methods.description: Synchronously inspects the state of a promise, returning an array with its status and value/reason.

methods.name: inspectAll
methods.description: Inspects multiple promises, returning their states.

methods.name: unwrap
methods.description: Waits on and retrieves the fulfillment values of multiple promises, throwing on rejection.

methods.name: all
methods.description: Returns a promise fulfilled when all input promises are fulfilled, or rejects if any reject.

methods.name: some
methods.description: Runs multiple promises and fulfills when a specified number have fulfilled, or rejects if not enough fulfill.

methods.name: any
methods.description: Returns the first fulfilled value among promises.

methods.name: settle
methods.description: Returns a promise that fulfills when all input promises settle, with an array indicating each promise's state.
